invariants.name: Replica convergence
invariants.scope: MemoryService active stateless service with eligible nodes and an allowed restart policy
invariants.assumptions: Pinned source, authorized context, specified constructor path and eventual successful calls; no durable/distributed guarantee inferred.
invariants.counterexample_outside_scope: Zero capacity or restart never can leave intent unfulfilled; initial immediate placement bypasses richer Plan constraints.

invariants.name: Atomic task claim
invariants.scope: Store-backed scheduler with consistent expected state/timestamp
invariants.assumptions: Pinned source, authorized context, specified constructor path and eventual successful calls; no durable/distributed guarantee inferred.
invariants.counterexample_outside_scope: One-winner claim does not establish default server persistence or remote process fencing.

invariants.name: State-change event ordering
invariants.scope: Agent status handler after validated in-memory state write
invariants.assumptions: Pinned source, authorized context, specified constructor path and eventual successful calls; no durable/distributed guarantee inferred.
invariants.counterexample_outside_scope: Memory mutation and append are not a durable transaction across process failure; do not generalize to every controller append.

invariants.name: Assigned node owns reports
invariants.scope: Known task and matching authorized node ID
invariants.assumptions: Pinned source, authorized context, specified constructor path and eventual successful calls; no durable/distributed guarantee inferred.
invariants.counterexample_outside_scope: Credential validity alone cannot authorize a different node’s task; physical old-worker activity is not fenced.

invariants.name: Namespace secrecy
invariants.scope: Context-scoped resource lookup before metadata returned
invariants.assumptions: Pinned source, authorized context, specified constructor path and eventual successful calls; no durable/distributed guarantee inferred.
invariants.counterexample_outside_scope: A global identifier must not be returned before scope validation; inspect every newer workload surface separately.

invariants.name: Rollout availability budget
invariants.scope: Controller snapshot with desired running old tasks and explicitly healthy new tasks
invariants.assumptions: Pinned source, authorized context, specified constructor path and eventual successful calls; no durable/distributed guarantee inferred.
invariants.counterexample_outside_scope: Running new tasks alone do not satisfy newHealthy; concurrent physical failure can invalidate a snapshot budget.

invariants.name: Owned container cleanup
invariants.scope: Agent removal path verifies node/task/managed labels before deleting
invariants.assumptions: Pinned source, authorized context, specified constructor path and eventual successful calls; no durable/distributed guarantee inferred.
invariants.counterexample_outside_scope: Server deleting status is not proof removal happened; cleanup can fail or old agent can remain unreachable.
